en.editorNote: For the strange, unwanted freedom that shows up after the caretaking stops
variations: Every empty square on that calendar used to have your name on it.
I can finally go anywhere on short notice. I'm sitting right here.

items.sourceNote: 網友票選最想念過世寵物的一件事，多半是日常小細節；改寫為家中專屬角落的物件自述

zh-tw.content: 我是玄關那個紙箱，本來裝的是礦泉水。牠來的第一天就跳進來睡，從那天起我就沒被拿去回收。這幾年我被壓得越來越扁，四個角都軟了，牠照樣天天窩進來。現在我還擺在原地，中間那個凹陷還在，再也沒有東西補上去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家裡還留著牠專屬那個角落、卻不知道該不該收的時候
variations: 那個凹陷的形狀，是照著你長的。
箱子還在，重量不在了。

en.content: I'm the cardboard box by the front door, the one that came with bottled water in it. She jumped in to sleep on her very first day here, and after that nobody ever carried me out to the recycling. Over the years I got flatter and my corners went soft, and she curled up in me anyway. I'm still sitting in the same spot with that dent in the middle, and nothing comes along to fill it now.
en.editorNote: For the corner of the house that's still hers, and the day you can't decide whether to clear it
variations: That dent is shaped exactly like you.
The box is still here. The weight isn't.

items.sourceNote: 毛孩離世後仍持續收到各種提醒通知造成二次心理創傷；改寫為寵物美容院的預約來電

zh-tw.content: 美容院打來，語氣還是很熟：「陳小姐，你們家那隻這次隔比較久喔，禮拜六早上有位子，要幫你留嗎？」我停了一下才回：「牠三月走了，謝謝你們這幾年。」那頭安靜了兩秒，然後她說：「那我把牠的資料留著，不刪喔。」我說好，掛掉才發現自己對著空氣一直點頭。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合還在被各種提醒電話和簡訊追著跑的那幾個月
variations: 有人願意幫你把牠的名字留在系統裡，這件事今天救了我。
掛掉電話那三秒，我才聽見自己的聲音有多穩。

en.content: The groomer called, same friendly voice as always: "Hey, it's been a while since his last wash, and Saturday morning is open if you want it." It took me a second to answer: "He passed in March, thank you for all these years." There were two seconds of quiet, and then she said, "I'll keep his file, I won't delete it." I said okay, and after I hung up I realized I'd been nodding at nobody.
en.editorNote: For the months when reminder calls and texts still keep finding you
variations: Someone offered to keep his name in the system, and that got me through today.
I didn't hear how steady my own voice was until after I hung up.

items.sourceNote: 毛孩老年與臨終照護的居家準備討論；改寫為照護用品留在抽屜裡的純場景白描

zh-tw.content: 抽屜第二層有一支寵物指甲剪，銀色的，握把上纏了一圈防滑膠帶。旁邊放著半包沒拆的紗布、一支小手電筒，還有一小罐止血粉。止血粉的蓋子沒轉緊，粉漏了一點在抽屜底，白白的一小片。我把抽屜推回去，推到底的時候聽見那支剪刀滑到最裡面。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合話說不出口、只想描述眼前那些東西的日子
variations: 那些東西都還在原本的位置，少的是會用到它們的人。
抽屜關上的聲音，比我想像中大。

en.content: In the second drawer there's a pair of pet nail clippers, silver, with a strip of grip tape wound around the handle. Next to them sit half a pack of unopened gauze, a small flashlight, and a little jar of styptic powder. The lid on the jar isn't screwed on tight and some powder has spilled across the bottom of the drawer, a small white patch. I push the drawer shut, and right as it closes I hear the clippers slide all the way to the back.
en.editorNote: For the days when you can't say anything and can only name what's in front of you
variations: Everything is right where it lived. The one who needed it isn't.
The drawer closed louder than I expected.

items.sourceNote: 網友分享愛貓離世後自動貓砂盆傳來使用紀錄的巧合；改寫為陽台上被風吹進砂的空砂盆

zh-tw.content: 那個貓砂盆前幾天終於刷乾淨了，倒過來晾在陽台角落。今天早上出去收衣服，看到盆底多了一小堆砂，被撥成一個尖尖的小山。我站在那裡沒動，心跳很快，什麼都不敢先想。蹲下去才看見旁邊那袋砂沒封好，昨晚的風整夜都在吹。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合曾經因為一個小巧合、整個人愣在原地的那種早晨
variations: 有那麼三秒，我真的以為你回來過。
後來我沒有把那堆砂弄平，就讓它留在那裡。

en.content: Last week I finally scrubbed the litter box and left it upside down to dry in the corner of the balcony. This morning I went out for the laundry and there was a small pile of litter sitting in the tray, pushed up into a little peak. I stood there without moving, heart going fast, not letting myself think anything yet. Then I crouched down and saw the open bag beside it, and remembered the wind had been going all night.
en.editorNote: For the mornings when one small coincidence stops you cold
variations: For about three seconds I really believed you'd come back.
I didn't smooth the pile out. I left it there.

items.sourceNote: 文中提到飼主常無法處理毛孩留下的用品；改寫為櫃子裡沒餵完的處方飼料與袋子上的保存說明

zh-tw.content: 那包處方飼料的袋子背面寫著：開封後請於三十天內餵完，餘量請夾緊袋口，置於陰涼乾燥處。夾子還夾著，袋子也還站在廚房下櫃的原位，剩三分之一。今天是第四十六天。我把袋口重新對折了一次，夾好，關上櫃門。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家裡還留著沒餵完的飼料、每次開櫃子都會看見的那段日子
variations: 櫃子裡還有兩包沒拆封的，我也還沒拿去退。
那個夾子我沒有拿去夾別的東西。

en.content: The back of the prescription food bag says to finish it within thirty days of opening, to fold the top down and clip it shut, and to keep it somewhere cool and dry. The clip is still on, and the bag is still standing in its place in the bottom kitchen cupboard, about a third full. Today is day forty-six. I folded the top over once more, clipped it, and shut the cupboard door.
en.editorNote: For the stretch when the half-finished bag of food is still in the cupboard
variations: There are two unopened bags behind it. I haven't taken those back either.
I haven't used that clip for anything else.

items.sourceNote: 文中提到喪寵者常被例行聯絡與詢問打斷情緒；改寫為動物醫院年度提醒電話裡沒講完的那句話

zh-tw.content: 動物醫院櫃檯打來提醒年度預防針，語氣很客氣，說月底前哪天過來都可以。我說好，接著想把事情交代清楚：我們家那隻，上個月已經……對方在那裡輕輕接了一句，說她這邊會把資料改掉。我道謝，她也道謝，兩個人都很有禮貌。掛掉之後我在椅子上坐了一下，那句話終究沒有講完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合接到例行通知電話、才發現自己說不完那句話的時候
variations: 現在看到不認識的號碼，我會先想一下要不要接。
她說要改的那筆資料，是我自己一直沒去改的那筆。

en.content: The clinic's front desk called with the annual vaccine reminder, very polite, saying any day before the end of the month would be fine. I said okay, then tried to explain properly: our girl, last month she already… and the person on the other end stepped in softly and said she would update the record on her side. I thanked her, she thanked me, both of us extremely polite. After I hung up I sat in the chair a while, and the sentence never did get finished.
en.editorNote: For the routine phone call where you can't get to the end of a sentence
variations: These days I look at an unknown number and think twice before answering.
The record she offered to change is the one I had never changed myself.

items.sourceNote: 文中提到愧疚是喪寵常見反應、可與獸醫討論當初的醫療決定；改寫為把自責清單帶去問醫生的建議

zh-tw.content: 朋友問我這種時候可以做什麼，我給了一個很認真的建議：把最後那三個月裡你覺得自己做錯的每一件事寫下來，帶去問醫生，一條一條問完。醫生會告訴你哪幾條根本不成立，剩下的那幾條，多半是因為你太想把牠留下來。這個建議我給得很誠懇。我自己那張紙寫好兩個月了，還躺在抽屜裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合安慰正在反覆檢討自己醫療決定的朋友
variations: 那張紙上有十一條，我最怕的是第三條。
抽屜我開過幾次，看一眼就關上。

en.content: A friend asked me what there was to do at a time like this, and I gave her advice I completely meant: write down every single thing from those last three months that you think you got wrong, take the list to the vet, and go through it line by line. She will tell you which ones don't hold up at all, and the ones left over are mostly there because you wanted so badly to keep him. I meant every word of that. My own list has been written for two months and is still lying in a drawer.
en.editorNote: For a friend who keeps going back over every decision they made
variations: There are eleven things on my list. Number three is the one I'm most afraid of.
I've opened that drawer a few times and closed it again.

items.sourceNote: 文中談毛孩離世後家中留下的空缺與情感斷裂；改寫為午後光線橫過牠常趴的位置、人整段時間沒有起身

zh-tw.content: 下午四點多，那塊光從玄關的地磚慢慢挪到書櫃腳邊，停在牠以前趴著等我出門的位置。冷氣室外機一直在滴水，一分鐘十幾下，樓下有人發動機車，發了三次才成功。門邊那條小毯子還是上個月摺好的樣子，邊角上有一撮沒清掉的毛。我坐在餐桌這邊，光走完那段路花了半個多小時，我沒有起來把毯子收走。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傍晚一個人在家、什麼事都做不動的時候
variations: 那塊光每天都會經過同一個地方。
毯子我還沒洗，也還沒收。

en.content: Around four in the afternoon the patch of light slides off the entryway tiles and over to the foot of the bookshelf, stopping at the spot where he used to lie waiting for me to leave. The AC unit outside drips steadily, a dozen or so times a minute, and someone downstairs tries a scooter three times before it starts. The small blanket by the door is still folded the way it was last month, with a bit of fur left in one corner. I stayed at the dining table; the light took a good half hour to cross that stretch of floor, and I never got up to put the blanket away.
en.editorNote: For late afternoons alone at home when nothing can be started
variations: The light crosses the same patch of floor every day.
I haven't washed the blanket, and I haven't put it away.

items.sourceNote: 喪寵後日常觸發點（grief triggers in routines）frame，原創改寫，場景改為深夜藥局

zh-tw.content: 凌晨一點多我又走進那間整夜亮著的藥局，這次買的是我自己的胃藥。以前這條路我走得比誰都熟，紗布、生理食鹽水、餵藥用的空針，都是為了你才站在這裡排隊。今天那一格還擺在同一個位置，我伸手到一半才停下來。你已經不需要這些了，我還是挑這種沒什麼人的時間出門。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合毛孩離開後幾個月、半夜睡不著時寫給牠的短文，也可放進紀念相簿內頁
variations: 那一格我沒有再走過去，可是每次結帳前都會往那邊看一眼。
半夜出門買藥的習慣是你留給我的，只是現在買的是我的份。

en.content: It's past one in the morning and I'm back at the pharmacy that stays lit all night, this time for my own stomach pills. I used to know this walk better than anyone — gauze, saline, feeding syringes, all of it queued up for you. That shelf is still exactly where it was, and my hand stopped halfway there. You don't need any of it now, and I still pick the hour when nobody else is out.
en.editorNote: For the sleepless months after a pet's death; gentle enough for a memorial album page
variations: I don't walk down that aisle anymore, but I glance at it before I pay.
The late-night pharmacy run is a habit you left me. Now the medicine is mine.

items.sourceNote: 喪寵後保留舊習慣、被旁人誤讀 frame，原創改寫，場景改為手搖飲店取餐區

zh-tw.content: 取餐區明明有位子，我每次都站到門口那根柱子旁邊，店員以為我怕人擠，還特地把飲料端過來給我。真正的原因有點蠢：那根柱子是以前綁牽繩的地方，站在那裡剛好看得到你趴在陰影裡。這幾個月我換了三家店，每一家我都自己找到一根那樣的柱子。少冰少糖可以備註，站哪裡這種事，好像沒有地方可以寫。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫給還保留著舊習慣、卻不好意思跟人解釋的飼主；語氣自嘲，不用哭
variations: 我到現在還是先看陰影在哪裡，才決定要站哪一邊。
有些習慣不用改，它只是換成一個人在做。

en.content: There are seats at the pickup counter, but I always end up by the pillar near the door — the staff think I hate crowds, so they bring the drink over to me. The real reason is dumber than that: the pillar is where the leash used to be tied, and from there I could see you lying in the shade. I've switched shops three times this year, and every time I find myself a pillar just like it. You can note down less ice and less sugar; there's no field for where you stand.
en.editorNote: For owners still keeping old habits they'd rather not explain; wry rather than tearful
variations: I still check where the shade is before I pick a spot to stand.
Some habits don't need fixing. One of us just does them alone now.

items.sourceNote: 喪寵後行政手續與陌生人善意 frame，原創改寫，場景改為銀行號碼牌區

zh-tw.content:
行員：先生，你這個帳戶的聯絡人暱稱要改嗎？系統上寫的是弟弟。
我：……那一欄可以不要動嗎？
行員：可以，我這邊就跳過去。
我：這樣不會被稽核唸喔？
行員：那一欄本來就沒有規定要填人。
我：謝謝你。
行員：號碼牌你先放著，坐一下再走沒關係。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合分享給正在跑各種手續、被一句陌生人的體貼接住的飼主
variations:
行員：資料我留著，不會幫你刪。
我：好。

我：那個名字我留了十四年。
行員：那就繼續留著吧。

en.content:
Teller: Sir, do you want to update the nickname on this contact field? The system says "Little Brother."
Me: ...can we leave that one alone?
Teller: Sure. I'll skip it.
Me: Won't that get flagged in an audit?
Teller: That field was never required to be a person.
Me: Thank you.
Teller: Keep your queue ticket. Sit as long as you need.
en.editorNote: For anyone getting through the paperwork after a loss and caught off guard by a stranger's kindness
variations:
Teller: I'll keep the record. I won't delete it.
Me: Okay.

Me: I've had that name on file for fourteen years.
Teller: Then keep it there.

items.sourceNote: 喪寵後難以對家人開口 frame，原創改寫，場景改為打烊前的量販店

zh-tw.content:
（草稿）姐，我在量販店，打烊廣播已經第三次了。
（草稿）最後一台收銀機的隊伍好長，我排在一個推了整車飼料的先生後面。
（草稿）他跟結帳的人說，家裡那隻十三歲了，這樣買比較划算。
（草稿）我差一點就跟他搭話。
（刪掉重打）
（送出）姐，你明天有空嗎，我想找你吃個飯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合形容那種話到嘴邊又收回去的狀態，也可貼給家裡有人正在難過的朋友
variations:
（草稿）我今天不太想那麼早回家。
（送出）沒事，就問一下。

（草稿）我剛剛在冷凍櫃前面站了很久。
（送出）明天見。

en.content:
(draft) Sis, I'm at the big store. That's the third closing announcement.
(draft) The last register has a long line. I'm behind a guy with a whole cart of kibble.
(draft) He told the cashier his dog is thirteen and it's cheaper to buy in bulk.
(draft) I almost said something to him.
(deleted, started over)
(sent) Sis, are you free tomorrow? I'd like to get dinner.
en.editorNote: For the state of almost saying it and pulling back; also good to send a friend whose family is grieving
variations:
(draft) I don't feel like going home yet.
(sent) Never mind, just checking in.

(draft) I stood in front of the freezer aisle for a while.
(sent) See you tomorrow.

items.sourceNote: 動保法曾預告禁止夜市撈金魚的相關報導，作為『夜市撈回來的魚活成家人』這個角度的背景素材

zh-tw.content: 留給下週來澆花的你：魚缸我還沒撤，過濾器也照樣開著，馬達有點吵，麻煩你忍一下。飼料罐在櫃子第二格，你不用餵，那罐我還沒收起來而已。牠是十年前夜市那攤撈回來的，那天紙網一直破，我換到第六張才把牠帶上車。冰箱有布丁，自己拿，走的時候門幫我帶上就好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合分享給正在整理毛孩遺物、卻遲遲收不掉某樣東西的人；也可以配一張還沒撤掉的空籠子或魚缸照片
variations: 留給明天來收包裹的你：紙箱堆在門邊那個先別動，最下面那個是牠的。其他你要拆要丟都可以。
貼在冰箱上：週末我不在，貓罐頭那一排先留著，我還沒想好要送給誰。

en.content: Note for whoever waters the plants next week: the tank is still up and the filter is still running, so sorry about the hum. Food's in the second shelf — you don't need to feed anyone, I just haven't put it away. We won him at a night market ten years ago; the paper scoop kept tearing and I went through six of them before he came home with us. There's pudding in the fridge, help yourself, just pull the door shut on your way out.
en.editorNote: For anyone still unable to pack away one specific thing; pairs well with a photo of an empty tank or crate that's still set up
variations: Note for the delivery guy: don't move the boxes by the door. The bottom one is his. Everything else, do what you want.
On the fridge: I'm out this weekend. Leave the row of cans where they are — I haven't decided who to give them to.

items.sourceNote: 2026 中元普渡日期與流程整理（農曆七月自 8/13 起、中元節 8/27），用來寫『普渡桌上多出一份』的節氣素材

zh-tw.content: 媽，我搭最晚那班車回去，你先睡不用等我。騎樓那張普渡桌我剛剛看過了，最邊邊多出一個小碟子，裡面裝了一小把小魚乾。我不會問你為什麼多買一份，我看到了，也覺得你放得剛剛好。桌子明天一早我來收，你多睡一下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 農曆七月、中元普渡前後很好用；適合家裡長輩從來不提、卻默默多準備一份的那種家庭
variations: 媽，供桌上那個小碟子我拍了一張，存在手機裡了，沒有要傳給誰。
爸，金紙我幫你補了一疊，最上面那幾張是我自己要燒的，你別動。

en.content: Mom — I'm on the last bus, don't wait up. I saw the offering table out front. There's an extra little dish at the far end with a small pile of dried fish in it. I'm not going to ask why you bought one more; I just want you to know I noticed, and I think you put it in exactly the right spot. I'll clear the table in the morning, so sleep in.
en.editorNote: Great around Ghost Month or any family memorial day; for households where the older generation never says it out loud but quietly sets an extra place
variations: Mom, I took a photo of that little dish. It's just sitting in my phone. I'm not sending it to anyone.
Dad, I added to the stack of joss paper. The top few are mine to burn — leave those.

items.sourceNote: 台灣光華雜誌談寵物殯葬與告別方式的轉變，延伸到『帳號與資料要不要一起結束』的當代情境

zh-tw.content:
【工單 A-08196】受理項目：智慧項圈定位服務，申請停用
帳號暱稱：客戶要求維持原樣，不更動
客戶說明：不用退費，方案到期就好
來電詢問：停用後歷史軌跡會不會一併刪除
客服回覆：軌跡資料留在帳號裡，不隨方案清除
客戶回應：那就這樣，謝謝你們
結案分類：非故障，客戶自行申請
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合分享給正在一個一個關掉毛孩帳號、卻捨不得刪資料的人；社群配圖可用手機設定頁截圖
variations: 【工單 B-04412】項目：寵物餵食器排程取消／備註：客戶請我們不要一併刪除排程紀錄
【工單 C-01207】項目：訂閱制飼料暫停／客戶回應：先暫停就好，不要幫我取消

en.content:
[Ticket A-08196] Request: deactivate GPS collar tracking
Account nickname: customer asked us to leave it as is
Customer note: no refund needed, let the plan run out
Question raised: will the location history be deleted too
Agent reply: history stays on the account, it isn't wiped with the plan
Customer response: okay then, thank you
Resolution: not a fault, customer-initiated
en.editorNote: For anyone shutting down their pet's accounts one by one but unable to delete the data; pair with a screenshot of a settings page
variations: [Ticket B-04412] Request: cancel feeder schedule / Note: customer asked us not to delete the schedule log
[Ticket C-01207] Request: pause food subscription / Customer: just pause it, don't cancel it for me

items.sourceNote: 立法院「寵物生命紀念管理法制之研析」，用來理解寵物禮儀業者的服務內容與現場流程

zh-tw.content:
Q：可以帶牠自己的毯子一起進去嗎
A：可以，天然材質為佳，現場會先幫您確認
Q：家裡小孩八歲，適合讓他到場嗎
A：由家長決定，旁邊有間可以隨時出來坐的休息室
Q：如果我當天講不出話怎麼辦
A：不用講，流程我們會帶，您在旁邊就好
Q：大概要多久才不會這麼難受
A：這一題我們沒辦法給您答案，很抱歉
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合分享給正在找寵物禮儀、光是看流程就會發抖的人；也可以傳給不知道該說什麼的朋友
variations: Q：我可以中途走出去嗎／A：可以，門不會關，您隨時出來都行
Q：要準備什麼／A：什麼都不用，帶您自己來就好

en.content:
Q: Can she go in with her own blanket?
A: Yes. Natural fibers are best; we'll check it with you first.
Q: My kid is eight. Should he come?
A: That's yours to decide. There's a side room he can step out to anytime.
Q: What if I get there and can't say anything?
A: Then don't. We'll walk you through it. Standing there is enough.
Q: How long until this stops hurting this much?
A: That's one we can't answer for you. We're sorry.
en.editorNote: For someone shopping for pet aftercare who shakes just reading the steps; also good to send a friend who doesn't know what to say
variations: Q: Can I step outside partway through? / A: Yes. The door stays open. Anytime.
Q: What should I bring? / A: Nothing. Just come.

items.sourceNote: DEARPET 談毛孩離世後遺物整理：不必設期限、不必全部丟掉，依自己的步調分類即可

zh-tw.content:
【二手書店收書問卷．第三題】
您願意讓這本《陪一隻老狗慢慢走》離開您的書櫃，主要是因為：（請單選）
　□ 買重複了
　□ 已經讀完
　□ 家裡放不下
　■ 已經用不到了
　□ 其他：＿＿＿＿＿
圈完那一格，我在櫃檯前站了一下才把單子放下。店員什麼都沒問，只是把封面擦乾淨，放到窗邊那排架子的中間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合正在整理毛孩留下來的書、器材、藥袋的人。那一格可以圈得很慢，也可以整張帶回家再說——這件事沒有截止日期
variations: 「□ 已經讀完」跟「■ 已經用不到了」，同一頁上只隔了一格，我中間走了三年。
那本書我留了很久才拿出門。真正卡住我的，是要在一張紙上，把原因寫成一句可以圈起來的話。

en.content:
[Used Bookstore Intake Form — Question 3]
Why are you letting go of "Walking Slow With an Old Dog"? (choose one)
　□ Bought it twice
　□ Already finished it
　□ No room at home
　■ Don't need it anymore
　□ Other: ＿＿＿＿＿
I circled one and stood at the counter a while before I set the form down. The clerk didn't ask. She just wiped the cover and slid it onto the middle of the shelf by the window.
en.editorNote: For anyone sorting through the books, gear, and half-used medicine a pet left behind. You're allowed to circle that box slowly, or take the whole form home first — there's no deadline on this
variations: "Already finished it" and "Don't need it anymore" are one line apart on that form. It took me three years to get from one to the other.
I kept that book for a long time before I carried it out the door. The hard part was having to put the reason into a sentence small enough to circle.

items.sourceNote: 蛹之生心理諮商所談「悲傷剝奪」：失去寵物的哀傷常不被社會允許表達，飼主容易獨自消化

zh-tw.content: 營火那頭有個人整晚沒講幾句話，零食傳到他手上，他接過來放在腿上，沒拆。他腳邊多攤了一張矮凳，椅面空著，火都快矮下去了還是沒人坐上來。後來他往火裡添了兩根柴，把外套脫下來蓋在那張凳子上，像是怕它涼。收東西的時候我才想起來，今晚這一圈只有我一個人，那張凳子是我自己從後車廂搬下來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合第一次一個人出遠門、卻還是習慣性多帶一份裝備的人。習慣比記憶老實，它會先把位置留出來，你才反應過來
variations: 整晚只有他不吃東西，也不看火，眼睛一直落在旁邊那塊空地上——後來我才發現，那塊空地在我的椅子旁邊。
有人以為他在等誰。他自己也是收帳篷的時候才確定，他等的人不會從山下上來了。

en.content: There was a guy across the campfire who barely said ten words all night; snacks came around and he'd take one, set it on his knee, never open it. He'd unfolded a low stool beside him, seat empty, and even as the fire burned down nobody sat on it. Later he fed two more logs in, took off his jacket, and draped it over that stool like he was worried it would get cold. Packing up, I remembered there was only one of us out here tonight, and that the stool was the one I'd carried down from my own trunk.
en.editorNote: For the first trip you take alone and still pack two of everything. Habit is more honest than memory — it saves the spot before you catch up to why
variations: All night he didn't eat and didn't watch the fire. He kept looking at the empty patch of ground beside him — which, I realized later, was beside my chair.
Someone assumed he was waiting for a friend. He only knew for sure while folding the tent that nobody was coming up the trail.

items.sourceNote: 臺北市社區心理衛生中心專題：陪自己走過寵物離世的痛，允許悲傷、不必急著走出來

zh-tw.content: 等叫號的空檔，我把那本舊存摺翻開，最後一頁只剩一行空格，行員說待會可以幫我換一本新的。往前翻，這兩年的紀錄我幾乎看都沒看就翻過去了。再往前，紙已經有點黃，有一整段時間每個月都印著同一家動物醫院，密得幾乎連在一起。翻到最前面那一行，十一年前的四月，我領了八百塊出來，走出這扇門的時候，還在想要幫她取什麼名字。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合翻到舊帳本、舊行事曆、舊相簿而突然停住的人。那些紙不會安慰你，可是它會誠實地告訴你，你陪了她多久
variations: 行員說舊的那本可以帶回去留著。我說好，然後把它放進包包最裡面那一格。
最後一頁停在去年，第一頁停在十一年前的春天。中間那些頁，是我這輩子最不想跳過的部分。

en.content: Waiting for my number at the bank, I opened the old passbook — one blank line left on the last page, and the teller said she could swap it for a new one in a minute. Flipping backward, I barely looked at the last two years. Further back the paper has gone yellow, and there's a long stretch where the same animal hospital prints every single month, so tight the lines nearly run together. On the very first line — April, eleven years ago — I took out eight hundred, and walking back out that door I was still trying to pick a name for her.
en.editorNote: For anyone who opens an old ledger, planner, or photo album and stops cold. Paper won't comfort you, but it will tell you honestly how long you got to stay
variations: The teller said I could keep the old one. I said thanks and slid it into the deepest pocket of my bag.
The last page stops at last year. The first page starts eleven springs ago. Everything between those two is the part of my life I least want to skip.

items.sourceNote: 2026 研究：約五分之一同時經歷過人與寵物離世的人，覺得失去寵物更難承受，且較易出現延長性哀傷症狀

zh-tw.content: 我是 C7 登機門左邊那排椅子，一天要接住幾百個人，多數人坐下就低頭看手機，起飛前十分鐘才想起自己的行李放哪。今天早上有位小姐坐在第三格，膝上抱著一個布袋，兩個小時沒放下來過，連去裝熱水都整個抱著走。廣播叫到她那一排的時候，她先低頭對著袋子說了一句話，我沒聽清楚，只知道她站起來的動作比坐下時慢了很多。她走進空橋前回頭看了我一眼，大概是怕漏了什麼——我這裡什麼都沒留下，她要帶回家的，一路都在她懷裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在外地送走毛孩、要一個人把牠帶回家的人。也適合提醒身邊的人：那個抱著袋子不放的旅客，正在做一件很重的事
variations: 我這排椅子見過很多趕時間的人。她是少數幾個，寧可整趟都抱著也不肯放到旁邊的。
她坐了兩個小時，什麼都沒吃。走的時候椅面上乾乾淨淨，連一根毛都沒有留下，她大概檢查過很多次了。

en.content: I'm the row of seats to the left of Gate C7. A few hundred people a day land on me; most sit down, look at their phones, and remember where their luggage is about ten minutes before boarding. This morning a woman took the third seat and held a cloth bag in her lap for two hours without once setting it down — she carried it with her even to fill her water bottle. When her row was called she leaned down and said something to the bag, too quiet for me to catch, and stood up far slower than she'd sat down. She looked back at me before the jet bridge, probably checking she hadn't forgotten anything; nothing stayed behind on me, and what she was taking home had been in her arms the whole time.
en.editorNote: For anyone who lost a pet away from home and has to carry them back alone. Also a reminder for the rest of us: the traveler clutching a bag they won't put down is doing something very heavy
variations: This row has held a lot of people in a hurry. She was one of the few who'd rather hold it the whole flight than set it down beside her.
Two hours, nothing to eat. When she left the seat was spotless — not one hair on it. I think she'd checked more than once.
